data.title: 初雪 · 炉火旁的约定
data.description: 炉火映在杯沿。她向你靠近一点，轻声问明天能否只陪她走一段路，得到回答后才露出笑意。
data.action: 双手捧杯，微微倾身看向镜头
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Sitting gracefully on a thick sheepskin rug beside a roaring stone fireplace in a mountain sanctuary, Pramanix cradles a steaming stoneware mug of spiced winter cider, leaning closer with an affectionate, tranquil smile. Dancing firelight casts amber warmth over her soft silver hair and patterned knit shawl, while outside the timber walls, a silent blizzard blankets the dark pine forest.
